notablePrerequisites: You control lands that can tap to add at least {7}{U}{U}{R}{R}.
description:
Activate the lands by tapping all, adding at least {7}{U}{U}{R}{R}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Turnabout.
Resolve the Turnabout copy, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat from step 3.
